title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Närvarostämpeln. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Närvarostämpeln
options.lineage: Swedish classroom attendance stamp and närvarolista
options.thesis: A lecture is real when it has been stamped: date first, then a three-line brief ready to copy into the school platform.
options.viewport: Phone: a cool gray-green form fills the screen. A large circular wet-ink date stamp is the lecture. Three brief rows sit under it. One action: Kopiera till skolplattformen. Delete is nowhere near it.
options.risk: If the stamp is a logo instead of the session itself, it becomes decoration on another notes app.

raised.raise: Destructive delete sits alone with empty space around it, never beside copy.
Stamp blue lives only on the mark and the primary action; the brief body stays dry ink on form paper.
Each screen has one gravity: record, or copy, never both.
Rank is scale: the stamp and date are monumental; labels stay one size.

options.label: Veckobrevet
options.lineage: The weekly parent letter Swedish teachers already write
options.thesis: The app is tomorrow’s veckobrev: one A4-shaped sheet, three short blocks, copy the whole letter.
options.viewport: Phone: a white photocopied letter. School-blue header with date. Three headed paragraphs. One action: Kopiera brevet.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: the artifact they already make, rendered as an app.

options.label: Nästa beslut
options.thesis: The teacher only ever sees the next decision: start, stop, or copy — one yellow band, one message.
options.viewport: Phone: a saturated yellow band hangs at the top with one instruction. Gate-scale clock or Kopiera. No second action on screen.
options.case: Wins product clarity: the job is a chain of single decisions. Loses identification: Schiphol yellow is not a Swedish classroom.
options.risk: Reads as a transit app if the yellow band is decoration instead of the only instruction.

options.label: Klippbänken
options.thesis: Lectures are frames on a perforated rail; the one you stopped on wears an orange tape flag; the brief hangs below as trims.
options.viewport: Phone: a black grain field. A horizontal perforated rail of dated lecture frames. Orange flag on today. Three brief trims pinned under the rail. Kopiera is a tape band.
options.case: Holds clarity: a lecture is a cut you can mark and copy. Loses identification: teachers do not live at a cutting bench.
options.risk: Orange-on-black can shout cinema instead of school if the frames are not dated lectures.

options.label: Grafitkonsolen
options.thesis: Sessions as persistent graphite panels; copy is the only accent; delete sits in empty space.
options.viewport: Phone: dark tiled panels. Transcript in one pane, brief in another. Isolated delete.
options.case: Loses both axes: teachers do not identify with an IDE, and a console hides the copy-ready brief.
options.kept: Destructive actions isolated by empty space.
options.risk: Looks like a developer tool, not a classroom witness.

options.label: Molnkanten
options.thesis: A plain paper field; color only as a thin fringe on the live recording.
options.viewport: Phone: wide white margins, achromatic brief, a mint-rose fringe only while recording.
options.case: Loses both axes: cloud optics are not a teacher’s world, and a fringe does not explain the brief.
options.kept: Color confined to an edge; the text field stays achromatic.

options.label: Regnträdgården
options.thesis: Each screen pulls toward one destination: the record button, or the copy action.
options.viewport: Phone: one dominant pull toward Spela in or Kopiera; everything else falls toward it.
options.case: Loses both axes: surreal gravity is not a classroom, and rain laws obscure the brief.
options.risk: Fantasy weather on a teacher tool.

options.label: Typsnittet
options.thesis: The date and the brief are the specimen: huge date, tiny labels, hierarchy by scale alone.
options.viewport: Phone: a giant date. Three short brief lines. A tiny Kopiera label.
options.case: Loses both axes: a foundry specimen is not a teacher’s ritual, and scale-only can hide the copy action.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A calm voice-memo app with a waveform, a transcript, and an AI summary card — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: large record button, live waveform, session list of dated notes, summary underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI notes app, by design.
